samples.summary: Divider drag ratio math (`track = rect.width - divider.offsetWidth`) has no test anywhere
samples.evidence: The diff changes how the split ratio is computed during a divider drag (dividing by `rect.width - divider.offsetWidth` instead of `rect.width`) and widens the divider from 7px to 25px, which makes the correction matter. `packages/notes/src/view/editor.test.ts` contains only mount/read-only/view-mode/undo-redo/theme/task/keymap cases (grep for `divider`, `splitRatio`, `note-divider`, `col-resize` in that file returns nothing), and a repo-wide grep finds no test referencing `note-divider` or `splitRatio` at all. A regression here (e.g. dividing by a zero/negative track, or panes drifting from the pointer) would ship unnoticed by the unit lane; the only assertion needed is a synthetic pointerdown/pointermove asserting the resulting flex percentages.

samples.summary: New touch-affordance styles on the divider (`touchAction: none`, 25px hit area, `boxSizing`) are asserted nowhere
samples.evidence: The stated purpose of the hunk is that touch drags previously never reached the resize handler and that the 7px band was untappable. These are cheap DOM assertions (`divider.style.touchAction === 'none'`, width/padding/boxSizing) but `packages/notes/src/view/editor.test.ts` has no divider test at all, so a later refactor that drops `touch-action` silently restores the exact bug this change fixes on phones — the same class of defect the change under review exists to fix.

samples.summary: Non-persistence and initial-read are only tested for viewMode; keymap and showAuthors are untested in both directions
samples.evidence: The layout's docstring claims per-browser keymap and blame-gutter preferences are read as initial values and never written back (shared-notes-layout.tsx:32-35, 52-53). The suite's own header says it pins "nothing written back to the visitor's stored preferences", but the only assertions are on `wafflebase:notes:viewMode` (test at lines ~183-196). Nothing seeds `wafflebase:notes:keymap`/`wafflebase:notes:showAuthors` to check they reach `NotesView`, and nothing checks that toggling them through the toolbar leaves the stored values alone — so a regression that persisted an anonymous visitor's keymap/blame choice over the owner's preference, or that ignored the stored ones, would pass green.

samples.summary: The shared-document call site now passes `token` to SharedNotesLayout, and that wiring has no test
samples.evidence: `<SharedNotesLayout resolved={resolved} token={token} />` is the only thing that makes the share-token uploader available on a note share link; the new test constructs the layout directly with `token="tok-1"`, and there is no shared-document test file (glob packages/frontend/src/app/shared/*.test.tsx returns only shared-notes-layout.test.tsx). If the prop were dropped or renamed, image upload on an editor-role note share link silently disappears (uploadImage becomes undefined) with every suite still green — and frontend has no tsc lane to catch a prop mistake either.

samples.summary: Mobile demotion is only asserted at first render; the 'render-only, not written to state' property it depends on is untested
samples.evidence: `effectiveViewMode` demotes a stored `both` to `edit` for the render only (shared-notes-layout.tsx:61-62), and the comment stresses the demotion must be reversible. The test 'starts in edit mode on a phone rather than a 50/50 split' only checks the initial `viewProps.current.viewMode === "edit"` at width 375. An implementation that instead called `setViewMode("edit")` would pass this test identically while permanently losing the visitor's `both` mode when the viewport widens back; no test varies the width after mount or asserts the underlying state is preserved.
